Treatment summary
Patient presents following a sideswipe collision during a lane change, with complaints
of cervical and lumbar strain. The mechanism and force of the reported impact are
consistent with the soft-tissue injury described, and no prior injury to the neck or
low back is known to this provider. Care was delivered over 38 visits, with additional
services layered in over successive months, a pattern of expansion that exceeds what
is typically expected for uncomplicated strain of this type. Cervical and lumbar
imaging was unremarkable, and on several occasions the patient was observed moving
with full range of motion outside the examination room, which does not align with the
restriction reported during fomral testing. Two similar charges dated the same day are
currently under review by billing for accuracy. Ongoing monitoring and a functional
reassessment are recommended before any further treatment is authorized.
